chest.description: Phase-2 candidate symptoms for chest-related disambiguation

candidates.text: Is the chest pain still present or worsening?
Are you still experiencing difficulty breathing or shortness of breath?
Do you hear wheezing or whistling sounds while breathing?
Do you currently have a cough?
Does the chest pain worsen with physical activity or exertion?

abdomen.description: Phase-2 candidate symptoms for abdominal / GI disambiguation

candidates.text: Is the abdominal pain still present or worsening?

Are you having loose stools or diarrhea?
Are you feeling nauseous?

skin.description: Phase-2 candidate symptoms for skin-related disambiguation

candidates.text: Is itching still present or worsening?

urinary.description: Phase-2 candidate symptoms for urinary / renal disambiguation

candidates.text: Is there still burning or pain while urinating?
